title: Artifact for "The Two Gates of ePBS: A Fixed-Seat Payload-Timeliness Orphaning and Builder-Griefing Surface"
description:
Reproducibility artifact for the paper. Contains a spec-anchored simulator port of the Ethereum ePBS (EIP-7732 / gloas) payment, settlement, payload-timeliness and fork-choice paths; the experiments cited by the paper (exp81-exp88, exp92-exp94); differential/conformance tests against the executable pyspec for the load-bearing predicates; and a bundled 493,330-block, eight-relay block-value extract so the economic tables reproduce with no external download.

Entry point: docs/PAPER3_ARTIFACT_README.md maps each paper section to its command. bash experiments/reproduce_paper3.sh regenerates every headline result in one invocation.

Pinned consensus-specs snapshot: ec1c01f5f10fb60636a022ae8944c912b6da35f8.
